title: PostgreSQL extension-script substitutions allow SQL injection through object names (CVE-2026-120153)
description: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in PostgreSQL extension-script substitutions that allows an attacker with database-level CREATE privilege to execute arbitrary code as the bootstrap superuser. This occurs when schema or owner names contain newlines or special substrings. The vulnerability affects PostgreSQL versions before 14.25, 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7. It requires a non-bundled extension with a vulnerable script pattern and is similar to CVE-2023-39417.
